description: Read-only. The workspace's top links over a date range, ranked by taps, app opens, installs or conversions, with each link's share of the total. Use it for "which links brought the most installs this month". Days are UTC; at most 92 days (default: the last 30).

by.description: What to rank by, default taps

from.description: Inclusive start: 2026-10-01, an ISO date-time or epoch ms

to.description: Exclusive end, same formats; default now

name: get_top_links
title: Rank the top links
